context_requirements: Active NAD+ salvage dependence and/or low NAPRT expression
Functional p53 for maximal apoptotic and cell-cycle transcriptional response
Proliferating cells with high NAD+ demand
Intact caspase/apoptotic machinery for late death-associated transcription
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any line
No induction of p53 targets such as CDKN1A or BAX at 24 h
No evidence of apoptosis or stress-response transcription at 24 h
Strong and equal transcriptional response in all nine lines at 6 h

evidence.supports: NAMPT inhibitor FK866 represses cancer cell proliferation and reduces NF-kB, VEGF, MMP2 and MMP9 expression
NAMPT inhibitor FK866 is selectively cytotoxic toward gastric cancer cells with EMT markers due to loss of NAPRT
FK866 induces p53 acetylation, p21 and BAX expression, apoptosis and cell-cycle arrest; p53-nonfunctional cells are relatively resistant
NAMPT inhibitor APO866 depletes NAD+ and synergizes with TRAIL to induce apoptosis in leukemia cells
NAMPT inhibitor FK866 induces caspase-dependent and caspase-independent apoptosis in ATL cells
